# Hardwood Specialists

> Hardwood flooring contractor in St. Petersburg, Florida, since 1989. Experts in the installation and finishing of exotic and native hardwood flooring and custom staircases. Florida contractor license C9359.

- Address: 2595 30th Avenue North, St. Petersburg, FL 33713
- Phone: (727) 322-9663
- Email: info@hardwoodspecialists.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm (closed Saturday and Sunday)
- Service area: St. Petersburg, Florida
- Services: hardwood floor installation; custom staircases; recoating and refinishing; custom work (inlays, borders, medallions)
- Showroom: exotic and native species, European wide-plank collections, inlays and parquet panels on display
